name: square-online
description: Manage Square Online storefront operations beyond Square's REST APIs. Snippets API automation for category-tile heros (4 design variants), API-only category publishing to the storefront nav (sparse channel add), a dashboard walkthrough for sort defaults, brand-guidelines and brand-voice skills, catalog-voice-audit and catalog-voice-rewrite, plus storefront-image-cache-bust for stale Weebly CDN image fixes.
